offering_description.value: Operates and franchises Wendy's quick-service hamburger restaurants, selling burgers, chicken and other fast food to consumers for on-premises, drive-thru and delivery orders. Most restaurants are owned and operated by franchisees who pay royalties to the parent company.

primary_products.value: hamburgers; chicken sandwiches; french fries; breakfast items; frozen desserts

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers dining in, ordering at drive-thrus, or ordering delivery

end_markets.value: quick-service restaurants; food service; consumer dining

revenue_model.value: product sales: food and beverages sold through company-operated restaurants; licensing or royalties: royalties and franchise fees paid by franchised restaurant operators; rental or leasing: rent received from franchisees for leased restaurant properties
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns the Wendy's brand, menu and restaurant system, licensed to franchisees; retailer: sells prepared food directly to consumers at company-operated restaurants

geography_served.value: North America: restaurants across the United States, with a smaller number in Canada and some international franchised locations

specialization.value: niche specialist: single quick-service hamburger restaurant brand

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated Wendy's restaurants; partners / resellers: franchised Wendy's restaurants operated by franchisees; online: mobile app and online ordering with third-party delivery services

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety, health inspection, labor and employment, and consumer protection rules enforced by local health departments and the FDA
